edit.ability:
(WOF) All enemy creatures have their SPD reduced by 25%.
If a creature attacks, or is attacked by this creature, its SPD is decreased by a further 25% during that attack.
If this card kills a creature, it summons an offensive minion with the stats of that killed creature but with -1 ATK -1 SPD.
Minions cannot act the turn they are created.
